privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what information {{displayName}} collects when you use {{domain}}, why, and the choices you have.
The site is run by [TODO: legal entity name], [TODO: registered address], which is responsible for your data. Privacy questions go to {{contactEmail}}.

p: - Account details: your email address, the name you give us, your language and your notification choices.
- What you create on the site, and your support requests and our replies.
- Payment records: what you bought, when, and the card's brand, last four digits and country. Stripe handles the card itself.
- Technical data: your IP address and country, browser and device type, and logs of requests, kept to run and secure the site.
- to provide the site and your account, and to keep them secure
- to take payments, give refunds and prevent fraud
- to send emails about your account, such as support replies, billing problems and account warnings
- to understand how the site is used and improve it, if analytics are turned on (section 4)

Where the GDPR or similar laws apply, we use your data to perform our contract with you, to meet legal obligations, for our legitimate interests in running a safe and working service, and, for analytics and advertising cookies, with your consent.
We use your browser's storage to keep you signed in and to remember your language.

If the site uses Google Analytics or Google AdSense, Google may set cookies to measure visits or show ads. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland these stay off until you agree in the consent message, and you can change your choice at any time. [TODO: remove this section's last paragraph if you use neither.]
We don't sell your personal data. We share it only with the services that run the site for us, under contracts that protect it:
- Amazon Web Services (hosting, sign-in and email)
- Stripe (payments)
- Google (analytics and ads, if turned on)
We may also share data when the law requires it, or to protect our users and the site.
Our providers may process data outside your country. Where the law requires it, transfers are covered by safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

We keep your account data while your account is open. Payment and audit records are kept as long as tax and accounting rules require. Request logs are kept for a short time. [TODO: set your retention periods.]

Depending on where you live, you can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Write to {{contactEmail}}. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
You can change your name, language and email notifications at any time in Settings.
The site is not meant for children under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their data.
We may update this policy. If a change matters, we will tell you on the site or by email.
